snippet.title: The Mirror Mysteries
snippet.description:
http://www.bigfishgames.com/download-games/6964/mirror-mysteries/index.html

A young family stops at a mysterious old home for a picnic and as the mother closes her eyes to enjoy the sun, she hears a horrific crash, the kids! As she enters the house, she is confronted by a mystical mirror thats taken her kids and locks them away in a magical world. A Hidden Object quest is placed upon you to not just save the children, but to help a unique character in very mystical places! Can you solve The Mirror Mysteries!?

  * Dark mystery
  * Immersive atmosphere
  * Find the children!
  * Check out our complete game walkthrough at http://www.bigfishgames.com/blog/the-mirror-mysteries-walkthrough/
